investmentToEmployment.Sector: How to use: This sheet provides the empirical capex-per-job ratios — derived directly from named, dated project disclosures in Project_Pipeline — that calibrate the 'Base Jobs/₹100cr' assumption used throughout Sector_SubSector_Master and Job_Forecast_3_6_12_24M. When new investment announcements are ingested, the system should classify them into one of these sector buckets and apply the blended-average ratio (with the high/low range as the sensitivity band) rather than a single fixed multiplier.

aiInsights.Generated Insight (Natural Language): Upcoming EV and electronics manufacturing investments in Tamil Nadu — anchored by the Samsung/Foxconn/Flex supplier ecosystem — are expected to generate approximately 15,800 engineering and operations jobs over the next 18 months, with confidence widening to a range of 11,900-19,000 jobs given typical PLI execution variance.
aiInsights.Traceable Inputs (sheet!cell logic): Job_Forecast_3_6_12_24M (TN rows) + Investment_to_Employment auto/electronics ratios + Vacancy_Gap_Analysis TN gap rows

aiInsights.Generated Insight (Natural Language): Gujarat's semiconductor corridor (Dholera-Sanand-Surat) is on track to create 8,200 fab and ATMP jobs by month-24, but only ~20% of this run-rate (roughly 1,640 jobs) will materialise by month-12 due to an 18-month average fab gestation period - recruiters should plan talent pipelines now, not later.

AI/ML hiring in Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR is growing faster than the trained-talent supply can absorb - the demand:supply ratio of 3.2x is the most acute skill gap nationally, and without emergency upskilling cohorts the gap is projected to exceed 19,000 unfilled roles by Q4 2026.

Food processing remains India's most labour-efficient PLI sector: at ₹0.96 crore investment per direct job (versus ₹7.84 crore for semiconductors), every ₹100 crore of new food-processing investment is estimated to generate roughly 3,682 direct jobs - the highest ratio of any tracked sector.

Hospitality is the fastest-growing non-IT hiring sector for three consecutive Naukri JobSpeak releases (+21% YoY as of Mar-2026); seasonal hubs in Goa, Rajasthan and Kerala should expect front-of-house and culinary-role vacancies to outpace trained graduates by roughly 12,000 positions over the next 6 months.

Karnataka's ₹10.27 lakh crore Global Investors Meet pledge (targeting 6 lakh jobs) carries meaningful execution risk: historical PLI achievement rates across India range from 19% to 136% of original targets, and the state's annual skilled-graduate output covers only a fraction of the pledged hiring scale - treat this as an upper-bound scenario, not a base case.

Traditional branch-banking roles are structurally declining (-15% YoY as of Jan-2026) as digital channels absorb transaction volume; this is not cyclical softness - job seekers and staffing firms in this segment should pivot toward digital-banking, relationship-management and fintech-adjacent roles rather than waiting for a rebound.
aiInsights.Traceable Inputs (sheet!cell logic): Vacancy_Gap_Analysis (BFSI surplus row) + Skills_Roles_Demand (Traditional Branch Banking row)

aiInsights.Generated Insight (Natural Language): Odisha's first compound-semiconductor fab (RIR Power Electronics, ₹618 crore) signals an early-mover opportunity for engineering talent outside the established Gujarat-UP semiconductor corridor - expect roughly 800 direct-plus-indirect jobs within 12 months, smaller in scale but with limited competing demand for the same skill pool.

Startup-funded EV mobility (Erisha E-Mobility, GreenLine, Euler Motors) is converting capital into jobs faster than traditional capex-heavy auto manufacturing - at an estimated ₹0.55 crore per job versus ₹1.85 crore for conventional auto plants, this segment offers the highest near-term (6-12 month) hiring velocity in the mobility space.
aiInsights.Traceable Inputs (sheet!cell logic): Investment_to_Employment (EV Mobility row) + Startup_Funding_Tracker (EV Mobility sector block)

aiInsights.Generated Insight (Natural Language): Maharashtra's ₹89,731 crore high-tech mega-project basket (coal gasification, solar cells, electrical steel, graphite anode) is dominated by capital-intensive segments - while it carries the second-largest investment figure in the tracked pipeline, its blended jobs-per-₹100cr ratio is among the lowest, implying job creation will lag the headline investment number by 12-24 months.
aiInsights.Traceable Inputs (sheet!cell logic): Project_Pipeline (P022-P025) + Investment_to_Employment (Coal Gasification, Battery Materials rows)

Back-test validation: PLI cumulative jobs (col D) compound from 9.8 lakh in FY24 to 14.39 lakh by FY26 — a 47% two-year increase, consistent with the gestation-period S-curve used in Job_Forecast_3_6_12_24M. Naukri JobSpeak Index growth (+97% over FY21-26) correlates with FDI and startup-funding cycles with an observed 2-3 quarter lag, supporting the model's assumption that investment announcements precede hiring by 1-2 quarters on average.

dataSources.Source / Publisher: Note on link format: Where a direct stable deep-link was retrievable, it is provided as a full URL.
